_meta.description: openspec change mcp-full-action-coverage. Declares the derived MCP tools OpenRegister serves for the CRM core: full search/get/create/update on contact and crmTask (the spec's `task`), create/update on client, and update/delete on leadProduct lines. lead and ticket keep search/get only: their writes are the curated LeadService/TicketService tools. Reach per tool (reads `user`, writes `instance`) is declared on the curated #[McpTool] attributes; on these derived entries it waits for openregister's x-openregister-mcp `reach` key (companion mcp-reach-annotation), whose validator refuses an unknown key today. Sorted last so the versions it stamps are the merged ones.

search.description: Search contact persons of clients by name, email or phone, optionally filtered by the client they belong to. Returns RBAC-scoped contact summaries.

get.description: Get a single contact person by id, with their role, contact details and the client they belong to.

create.description: Add a contact person to a client. Only name is required; give client (the client uuid) to link them.

update.description: Change fields of an existing contact person, such as their role, email or phone.

search.description: Search CRM tasks, optionally filtered by type (callbackRequest, followUpTask or informationRequest), status or the client they are for (clientId). Returns RBAC-scoped tasks.

get.description: Get a single CRM task by id, with its type, deadline, assignee and the client, lead or contact it is about.

create.description: Create a CRM task. subject and type are required; type is one of callbackRequest (call the client back), followUpTask or informationRequest. Give clientId, leadId or contactId to link it.

update.description: Change fields of an existing CRM task, such as its deadline, priority, assignee or result text.

create.description: Create a client: a person or an organization. name and type (person or organization) are required; email, phone, address, website, industry and notes are optional.

update.description: Change fields of an existing client, such as its contact details, industry or notes.
Correct a priced line on a lead: its quantity, unitPrice, discount, discountType or notes. Do NOT send `total`: OpenRegister calculates it and does not accept a written value.

delete.description: Remove a priced line from a lead, by id. The line is gone from the offer.
